name: Crystal Vale
summary: In northwestern Silithus, Crystal Vale gathers stone, wind, and ancient power. Jagged spires rise above rocky flats where earth and air elementals roam among rich ore veins. Potent summoning magic here is tied to the ancient elemental lords.

sections.title: A Confluence of Stone and Wind
sections.body: Crystal Vale cuts a rocky basin into southern Silithus. Steep cliffs frame shimmering mineral formations, earthen elementals, and roaring whirlwinds of living air. Rich thorium draws a few prospectors, though the valley remains dangerous. Hostile elementals guard ground shaped by the primal conflicts of ancient Azeroth.

sections.title: The Slumber of the Windseeker
sections.body: Highlord Demitrian lingers in Crystal Vale with secrets about Prince Thunderaan, the Windseeker. Those who bring the fallen prince's severed elemental bindings and the rarest forged metals are directed to the valley. There, the imprisoned lord of air can be drawn from his bindings and faced in open battle.

faq.q: Where is the Crystal Vale located?
faq.answer: Crystal Vale lies in far northwestern Silithus, against the mountainous rim that borders the desert.
Aggressive air and earth elementals roam among the valley's mineral outcrops.

faq.q: Who is Highlord Demitrian and why is he here?
faq.answer: Highlord Demitrian lives alone in Crystal Vale and knows much about Prince Thunderaan. He aids champions who can reunite the Windseeker's bindings and summon the elemental prince.

faq.q: What is the Ravaged Twilight Camp?
faq.answer: Ravaged Twilight Camp is the wreckage of a Twilight's Hammer encampment in the valley. Violent elementals have shattered and overrun it.

angles.text: Crystal Vale's craggy edges and canyon walls hold rich thorium veins. Mining can be lucrative there, but the valley is hazardous.
As a shaman, you can witness the raw clash between earth and air spirits in Crystal Vale. It recalls the elementals' unrestrained chaos across Silithus.
